name: Maghagha

queries.query: Maghagha Egypt cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS
queries.result: The Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) was identified as the first-party national survey/cadastral custodian. Its official services and digital-map pages describe cadastral and mapping products, but no public Maghagha parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API was found.

queries.query: المغاغة مصر خريطة كادسترية سجل عقاري خرائط رسمية
queries.result: Arabic discovery returned the official ESA map/service pages and an official Egyptian Tax Authority Maghagha office page. The tax page is local administrative coverage, not cadastral custody. No public Maghagha parcel-vector viewer or API was identified.

portalsFound.observation: Official Egyptian Survey Authority site; describes national survey, property-map and cadastral-record responsibilities.
Official services index lists digital maps, coordinate certificates, boundary separation and land-allocation procedures; no public parcel query endpoint exposed.
Official digital-map workflow requires a requested location, scale, layers and projection and is a procurement/contact process, not an anonymous parcel viewer.
Official national eGIS ArcGIS catalog inspected for parcel/cadastre services; no clearly identified public Maghagha parcel layer found.
Official Egyptian Tax Authority page identifies Maghagha tax-office coverage; not treated as a cadastral registry or geometry source.

requests.assessment: Official ESA history page reachable; it states the authority created ownership maps and land registers, but provides no public parcel API.
Official service list reachable; no anonymous parcel endpoint.
Current HTML/ASP.NET form and JavaScript/configuration inspected; only map-scale selection and a server-side purchase workflow were exposed, with no parcel geometry service.
Official map index reachable; linked products are national/reference maps, not Maghagha parcel polygons.
National eGIS service catalog returned anonymously; search of service names found no clearly cadastral Maghagha service.
Candidate service metadata returned; layers are entities and broad administrative polygons, not parcel fabric. No parcel query was retained or represented as a parcel hit.
Maghagha local tax-office page reachable; local administrative presence only, not cadastral geometry custody.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ESA has national survey and cadastral-map responsibilities and offers digital-map products by request.
coverageAssessment.cityRegistryBasis: National first-party ESA custody/procedure is evidenced; no Maghagha-local public cadastral registry or open parcel geometry service was evidenced.
